Experience providing customer support via phone, email, chat, and social media

As a Real-Time Analyst (RTA), you will work closely with colleagues and partners to help ensure the smooth operation of our global network, identifying challenges in real-time and coordinating resolutions to maintain a strong customer experience.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Partner with the broader Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) team, Workforce Management (WFM), and external partners to work toward shared KPIs.
Coordinate with partner RTAs to help them hit established SLAs on an hourly basis.
Share observations and suggestions for improvement through regular reporting.
Work across multiple systems together with the team to align skills and queues with customer demand.
Continuously monitor channels and coordinate responses to challenges according to agreed-upon processes.
Collaborate on root cause analysis of DTC service-level agreement (SLA) outcomes.
Support external partners through training to help set clear expectations in daily routine.
cond_0648.requirements:
2+ Years experience in customer support roles, preferably with experience providing customer support via phone, email, chat, and social media
Proficiency in Excel
Ability to stay calm under pressure with a keen sense of urgency when required.
Great attention to detail and process skills
Effective communication across all levels and functions
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Proven capacity to maintain a strategic perspective when confronted with competing priorities.
Previous experience as part of a WFM team, either as an RTA or a scheduler a plus
